cases.description: Named-machine performance qualification (Q): 10,000 instanced circles and, separately, 10,000 instanced quads into an offscreen 1920x1080 RGBA8 target, one DrawInstanced* per frame, 10-s warmup + 60-s sample each, timing that includes a RenderCommand::FinishGpu() completion fence per frame and NO read-back in the timed region (vsync off; no present). Records mean/p50/p95/p99/max complete-frame ms, CPU-submit ms, GPU timer-zone ms, draw counts and the machine; bar p95 <= 16.67 ms, p99 <= 33.33 ms. Correctness is asserted separately (1 instance draw/frame, 10,000 instances, non-blank frame). Applies to the named configuration only.
